design: router with _TREES replaced by forced leaves (lock tape T for blocks 1-4), 4 seeds each, both seats (s=seed%2)
verdict_tree_retrain: FALSIFIED. Every lock loses H2H to verbatim routing (twin army punishes rigidity); baseline beats or matches every lock vs every non-twin class; non-twins are already 4-0 for all conditions -> no flippable games via routing. Feature space saturated: trees use shop-unlock (x28=YARN count) + milk demand (x35) + carrot price (x4); rival features never used, but no gate on rival build can separate Ant-class from twins because router herd IS Ant-class.

diagnostics_herd.note: Census 5C/4S/4G was PER-TAPE buys; router accumulates across d0/d6 switches to 17 animals. Herd-scale gap vs Ant-class ~ zero. Wheat tile ~$55/day vs goose ~$15/day -> geese cannibalize wheat tiles; tapes are tile-optimal.
diagnostics_herd.revenue_attrib_seed201_202: Router: MELON/FERT/WHEAT/MILK 6-11k each + STRB 1-5k + EGG 1k; Ant: FERT/WHEAT/MILK/MELON similar, STRB 0-5k, WOOL ~0. No exploitable product gap. Router beats ant_tape_v26 by +21k to +51k on 5 seeds (avg +38k).

verdict_herd_scale: FALSIFIED at diagnosis: (1) router already runs 17-animal herd matching Ant-class; (2) no empty-tile headroom without cannibalizing wheat (higher $/tile); (3) no gate separates Ant-class from twins (same herd class) -> any anti-Ant branch breaks twin tie symmetry (8.5 BT pts) ; (4) eggs uncrashable but thin (~1k/game); (5) local Ant proxy loses to router 6-0 by $38k avg -> live losses are context, not class.
